vision: A conductor for LLM-powered development: register all LLM subscriptions/CLIs once, assign providers to roles via quota-aware rules, be interrogated into an unambiguous PRD/AGENTS.md/skills per project, run projects and tasks in parallel under a single-writer orchestrator, and monitor sessions, tokens and quotas in an AppCUI TUI or via headless CLI.

goals.text: First-class support for API providers, CLI-subprocess providers, and Ollama (local + cloud + remote via SSH)
Declarative role-to-provider routing rules with quota-aware fallbacks

Hybrid quota tracking: API usage parsing, billing endpoints, CLI output parsing, manual budgets, local estimation; unified dashboard. Estimation + manual budgets done; billing endpoints and CLI output parsing missing.
PRD/AGENTS.md/skill generation at the core, driven by an exhaustive clarification engine. Pre-project interview done; mid-project ambiguity detection missing.
Parallel projects and parallel tasks; single-writer orchestrator with write queue as the only file mutator. Parallel tasks + single writer done; multi-project in one process nominal.
TUI-first (AppCUI) with fully scriptable headless CLI
Secrets in OS keychain with encrypted-file fallback

non_goals.text: Not a model provider: no inference, no fine-tuning
No cloud sync / multi-user / team features in v1
No GUI front-end; TUI + CLI only (experimental egui/Dear ImGui GUI existed and was retired in commit 8c51951)
No automatic merging of semantic conflicts

terminology.provider: Registered source of LLM capability: api | cli | ollama-local | ollama-cloud | ollama-remote (SSH tunnel, D8)
terminology.model: Concrete model exposed by a provider
terminology.role: Named workflow function (planner, summarizer, coder, tool-runner, image-reader, image-writer, doc-reader, doc-writer, reviewer, interrogator, custom)
terminology.rule: role + condition -> ordered provider fallback chain
terminology.subscription: Provider account with credentials, plan limits, renewal date, tracked consumption
terminology.project: Unit of work stored as directory ~/rolen-workspaces/<id>/ with rolen-project.yaml; id is a lowercase slug of the name; DAG lives in tasks.yaml
terminology.task: DAG node; assigned a role; executed by one agent session
terminology.session: One running agent loop bound to a task, streaming events and token usage
terminology.orchestrator: Scheduler + sole owner of the write queue; only component allowed to mutate project files
terminology.write_ticket: Atomic file-mutation request {task_id, path, op, content|diff, base_hash} (priority field dropped in implementation)
terminology.interrogator: Clarification engine role generating questions from PRD gaps/ambiguities
terminology.skill: Reusable capability package suggested or installed for a project

personas.name: Solo power developer
personas.description: Owns 3-8 LLM subscriptions, codes daily, wants maximum throughput per dollar, works on several repos at once

use_cases.text: Register a new provider in under 2 minutes via guided wizard; 'rolen provider detect --register' auto-discovers Ollama and CLI agents
Write quota-aware routing rules via TUI rule editor or YAML
Start a project: 'rolen project new' -> 'project interview' -> 'project build' produces PRD.md -> PRD.json -> AGENTS.md -> skills -> task DAG
Parallel tasks within one spec work ('rolen batch'); one process runs one spec at a time; alerts notify-only; no quota forecast yet
Headless CI runs exist ('rolen run --role R --task ... --json', 'rolen batch --spec tasks.yaml --watch') with safe exit codes; planned '--project P --task T --headless' semantics missing
Automatic fallback with context hand-off when a provider hits its limit (mid-session migration)

items.text: Register/edit/remove providers of types api, cli, ollama-local, ollama-cloud, plus ollama-remote (SSH tunnel)
Provider wizard: endpoint/CLI-path detection, auth test, model discovery; capability probing only fills context_tokens/streaming for Ollama; vision/tools never probed for API providers
Health checks on demand only; no timer-based probes, no latency history
Persisted model capability matrix with editable overrides
Cost table per model, beyond spec: cache-read/write rates, billing kinds (Free/PerToken/Subscription), manual model entry (pricing.toml, Model Prices window)
Store secrets in OS keychain via keyring crate; config holds key references only
age-encrypted fallback vault (vault.age) with master password via ROLEN_VAULT_PASSWORD
Env-var injection for headless/CI: ROLEN_KEY_<KEY_REF> (sanitized key ref); ROLEN_SECRETS_BACKEND forces a backend
Secrets absent from config/logs by construction; no active redaction layer - wrapped-CLI PTY transcripts written verbatim
Built-in role catalog plus user-defined roles
Rule DSL (YAML canonical rules.yaml + TUI editor): conditions on quota_remaining_%, cost_so_far, task_type, project, time_of_day, provider_health; ordered fallback chain
Rule evaluation at dispatch and mid-session on quota-exceeded events (session migration with Migrated event)
Dry-run/explain: 'rolen rule dry-run --role X' + TUI editor dry-run panel
Rule-level project_scope works; Project.rules_override never read; P2 learned cost/latency heuristics absent

API providers: usage parsing from responses incl. cache buckets; billing-endpoint polling data-driven via quota_url + quota_json_path in providers.toml, on demand with 'rolen provider sync-quota' (no automatic timer)
CLI providers: chars/4 estimation + manual budget; CLI quota-output parsing via adapter quota_args/quota_regex in cli-adapters.toml, run by 'rolen provider sync-quota'
Ollama local: unlimited-but-metered counting

Subscription profiles: plan limit, cycle start + renewal dates ('rolen provider budget --cycle-start/--renewal'), projected exhaustion via burn rate; synced numbers (Api/Parsed) override ledger estimates

Threshold alerts (default 80%/95%) with all actions: notify (TUI popup), switch-rule (provider auto-suspended, fallbacks engage; 'rolen provider suspend/resume'), pause-role (roles paused until 'rolen rule resume --role X')
SQLite ledger of every request (tokens incl. cache buckets, cost, latency, task, session) plus CSV/JSON export via 'rolen export --what ledger|sessions|tickets --format csv|json'

functional_requirements.group: FR-5 Project Core: PRD, AGENTS.md, Skills

items.text: Project scaffolding wizard: name, workspace dir, git init, stack

PRD builder: draft PRD.md from interview, schema-versioned PRD.json with 'rolen prd --validate'; TUI Build shows a review preview (full content first build, unified diff on rebuild) with Apply/Discard
AGENTS.md generator from PRD.json + stack + skills; regeneration is diff-previewed (patch::simple_diff) and needs Apply; still manual Build-triggered, no automatic change detection
Skill suggestions from local registry (built-in + user dirs), one-click install
PRD sections to initial task DAG proposal (tasks.yaml via daggen)
Pre-planning question batches covering scope edges, data models, error handling, auth, performance, platforms, i18n, accessibility, testing, deployment, licensing, definition-of-done

Answers recorded into PRD.json clarifications[] with timestamps; TUI forms with real controls (radio buttons for options, text field otherwise, explicit defer) in both interview and Questions tab; no datepicker questions yet

ask_user records a pending question (with task_id) into rolen-project.yaml - visible in the TUI Questions tab; the scheduler pauses tasks whose transitive dependencies have unanswered questions; the asking task proceeds with a documented assumption
Question modes: thorough (14 topics, default) / balanced (8) / minimal (4)
Question <-> answer traceable via PRD.json; linked_prd_path always null, no question <-> task linkage
Orchestrator is the only component that writes project files; agents emit write tickets
Write ticket schema: task_id, path, op(create|patch|replace|delete|rename), content|diff, base_hash (priority field dropped)
Global write queue with per-path FIFO serialization; disjoint paths apply concurrently
Optimistic concurrency via base_hash (stale rejected, agent re-reads/re-issues); orchestrator-mediated read-your-writes missing - reads go straight to disk
Planner/scheduler assigns path ownership; overlapping claims block; honesty check fails tasks whose claimed files were never written
Atomic writes via temp-file + rename
Ticket journaling in SQLite; git auto-commit checkpoints per completed task

Backpressure done: parallelism.queue_cap (default 1000) blocks submitters when full; live queue depth in the TUI appbar from the cross-process ticket journal. Remaining: per-project fairness quotas (needs multi-project runs)
Unified-diff patch tickets applied with fuzzy 3-way context matching (declared position, then unique-match search); ambiguous/failed hunks reject the whole ticket
Parallel DAG execution with configurable caps (CPU heuristic + per-provider limits); N projects concurrently in one process missing - one spec per batch run
Workspace isolation via separate directories under ~/rolen-workspaces; P1 git-worktree mode missing
Session-per-task streaming events to the orchestrator bus

Cancel via Ctrl+C on run/batch (graceful, between steps); cancelled sessions marked interrupted with context snapshot, resumable via 'rolen run --resume'; cooperative pause flag pauses agents (session marked paused, snapshot written). Remaining: TUI pause buttons, wrapped-CLI checkpointing (P1)
Dependency-aware scheduling: task unblocks only when predecessors completed and their tickets applied
Dashboard per session: role (schema-migrated column), provider/model, state, tokens, cost, rate (tokens/min), elapsed; no last-event column (transcript covers it)
Per-provider panels: quota %, today's tokens/cost, burn rate (tokens/day) and exhaustion forecast for budgeted providers (gauges remain text - cosmetic)
Transcripts now written for every built-in-runtime session (transcripts/<session>.md) and viewable in the TUI; quick-chat sessions still transcript-less; viewer read-only without search/export

TUI popup notifications; OS toast on critical quota alerts (opt-in general.os_notifications + Settings checkbox; PowerShell balloon/osascript/notify-send). Remaining: toasts for pending questions and task failures
Historical analytics not implemented

functional_requirements.note: Implemented as six tabs: Dashboard, Projects, Providers, Rules, Questions, Activity

items.text: Dashboard: sessions listview + provider quota (text %); no progress-bar gauges, static queue-depth label, no alerts ticker
Providers screen: table, wizard dialogs, capability matrix; no health graph view
Rules editor: condition builder, fallback-chain editor with up/down ordering, dry-run panel

Projects screen: treeview (project -> tasks from tasks.yaml -> their sessions) with pending-question/PRD/AGENTS marks; Enter opens the project detail window (PRD.md/AGENTS.md/skills/clarifications tabs) or a session transcript
Chat/Session view: Quick Chat window (multi-turn, ledgered) but cannot steer a running agent session; Activity tab shows live PTY output read-only; no ticket/ledger side panel
Interrogation center: Questions tab lists pending question batches across all projects with answering
Menus, mouse support, 13 named themes with live switching + persistence (beyond spec); keybindings hardcoded, not configurable
No split layouts; in-TUI project/batch run is a stub

functional_requirements.note: Binary 'rolen'; actual subcommands: tui, config, provider, quota, rule, run, batch, project, prd, cli

items.text: Implemented: provider (add/remove/models/test/detect/health/budget/suspend/resume), rule (init/list/add/remove/dry-run/pause/resume), project (new/list/interview/build/skills), prd, quota, run (incl. --resume), batch, cli, config (incl. export/import), sessions, export, tui. Missing vs plan: top-level agents, skills

'rolen run --role R --task <desc> [--json --resume ...]'; 'rolen run --project P [--task T]' runs a task id from the project's tasks.yaml or the whole DAG when omitted; --headless accepted for CI parity; exit codes 0/1/130
TUI and CLI mutate the same single core library
NDJSON event stream implemented as 'rolen batch --watch'
Agent loop: chat with tool calls until done (retry, tool-call salvaging, completion nudges)
Standard tools: read_file, search, list_dir, run_shell (sandboxed, allow-listed), submit_write (write ticket), ask_user (stub, see FR-6.3); no direct write_file tool

Context management: near the context limit the middle of the history is LLM-summarized into a structured hand-off note (goal/decisions/files/open questions/next steps), ledgered; drop-middle fallback when the model is unreachable
No MCP client anywhere in the codebase
Spawn CLI agents as PTY subprocesses (portable-pty/ConPTY); output forwarded as raw chunks - no semantic stream-parsing
Overlay + harvest: staging-copy overlay; writes diffed, harvested and re-applied through the orchestrator write queue (single-writer guarantee holds for CLI providers)
Data-driven adapters: cli-adapters.toml [[adapter]] entries (match + args template) extend/override built-in templates with no recompile (NFR-6); remaining: per-CLI quota parsers
Human-editable config (config.toml, providers.toml, rules.yaml per D2, subscriptions.toml, pricing.toml) under ~/.config/rolen (XDG) / %APPDATA%\rolen, plus skills/ library dir
SQLite state DB (ledger.sqlite3: ledger, sessions, ticket journal, PRD cache) with schema migrations
'rolen config doctor' validates; SQLite schema versioned/migrated; config.toml itself has no schema-version field or migrations
'rolen config export [--out file]' writes a JSON bundle of config/providers/rules/subscriptions/pricing (secrets excluded); 'rolen config import --from file' restores with .bak backups

non_functional_requirements.text: Platforms: Windows 10+, macOS 13+, Linux; x64 + arm64 (CI builds all targets)
Performance: <100ms input latency; >=20 concurrent sessions; >=200 write tickets/s (not benchmarked)
Reliability: crash-safe journaling; restart reconciles tickets and marks sessions recoverable/interrupted
Security: keychain/vault secrets, sandboxed shell tool with per-project allow-lists, no telemetry by default
Testability: UI-free rolen-core; >=70% coverage target on routing/write-queue/ledger not measured; golden-file tests for generators
Extensibility: skills (SKILL.md registry) and CLI adapters (cli-adapters.toml) are data-driven, no recompile

architecture.write_path: agent/runtime/CLI-adapter -> write ticket -> orchestrator queue (per-path FIFO, disjoint-path concurrency) -> atomic temp+rename -> journal -> git checkpoint

implemented_beyond_prd: Quick Chat window (Ctrl+Q): multi-turn ledgered conversation with any provider
Settings window (F10): workspace root, theme, question mode, parallelism caps, alert thresholds
13 named colour themes with live switching and persistence; offscreen theme-verification tooling (docs/theme_report.py)
Model Prices window: cache-read/write rates, billing kinds (Free/PerToken/Subscription), manual model entry
Activity tab: live PTY output of a wrapped CLI task
Anthropic OAuth subscription import from opencode auth.json with auto-refresh (D9)
CLI extras: provider detect [--register], provider budget, provider test, rule init, rule dry-run, batch, cli run, config path
Agent-loop robustness: tool-call JSON salvaging, completion guard, scheduler honesty check

planner-level path ownership, reviewer role, git checkpoints

resolved_decisions.question: License
resolved_decisions.decision: MIT (changed 2026-08-16 from dual MIT OR Apache-2.0)

resolved_decisions.question: Rule DSL format
resolved_decisions.decision: YAML canonical (rules.yaml); TUI edits round-trip to YAML

resolved_decisions.question: CLI agent file writes
resolved_decisions.decision: Overlay + harvest: writes re-applied via orchestrator queue (FR-13.2)

resolved_decisions.question: Session migration format
resolved_decisions.decision: Structured snapshot + summary (goal, decisions, task state, condensed conversation, file manifests)

resolved_decisions.question: Default parallelism cap
resolved_decisions.decision: CPU heuristic max(2, logical_cpus/2) + per-provider concurrency limits, user-tunable

resolved_decisions.question: Windows PTY
resolved_decisions.decision: portable-pty (ConPTY on Windows) for all CLI adapters

resolved_decisions.question: Remote Ollama
resolved_decisions.decision: ollama-remote provider type: managed ssh -N -L port-forward (system ssh, ~/.ssh keys, BatchMode); provider uses local forwarded port

resolved_decisions.question: Anthropic subscription auth
resolved_decisions.decision: OAuth access/refresh tokens imported from opencode auth.json, stored as JSON secret, auto-refreshed; anthropic-beta oauth-2025-04-20 header

resolved_decisions.question: Project identity
resolved_decisions.decision: Project id = lowercase slug of the name (also the workspace directory name); lookup accepts id or case-insensitive display name; no UUID registry (added 2026-09-02)
